items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

ctx.x: Tom Brown syncopated novelty orchestra. And Earl Corder did this. He dated it 1921. He must have done the drawing. He signed it.
Yes, uh-huh. It was between 21, I guess, and 22. He was a drummer.
And he was a drummer and an artist, too. And a drummer.
